geometry.units: mesh normalized so its longest axis = 2.0, not metric

mesh2splat.pipeline: area-uniform surface sampling -> one thin disk-Gaussian per sample (oriented to the local normal) -> smooth (Phong) normals -> baked lambert shading

caveats: Direct mesh->splat conversion (no photography, no COLMAP, no training): the geometry is exact, the appearance is a baked matte shading, not real captured lighting.
Ships in four levels of detail (10k/100k/500k/1M gaussians); colour encodes the level (red/yellow/green/blue).
Spherical harmonics are absent (flat colour), so there is no view-dependent shading.
